title: Three hypotheses under which a relative Proj is quasi-compact
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file divisors.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for a quasi-coherent graded O_S-algebra A, the relative Proj p : Proj_S(A) -> S is quasi-compact if A is of finite type as an A_0-algebra, or generated by A_1 with A_1 finite type over A_0, or A_+ is generated up to locally nilpotent quotients by a finite type A_0-submodule (source lines 7646-7664). The proof reduces to S affine, and in case (1) chooses finitely many homogeneous generators so that A_+ is generated by them, in case (3) spreads a finite generating module into finitely many homogeneous elements whose radical contains A_+, and in both cases applies the quasi-compactness criterion for Proj of a graded algebra; case (2) follows from (1).
